block.createairspace.light_panel.tooltip: A _ceiling or wall light_ that joins with neighbouring panels into one _lit surface_.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
block.createairspace.light_strip.tooltip: A _light band_ that joins with neighbouring strips into one _line_.
On _floors and ceilings_ it runs the way you are _looking_. On _walls_ it runs _horizontally_, _sneak_ while placing to run it _vertically_.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
block.createairspace.floor_light.tooltip: A small _light set into the floor_ that you can walk over.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
A floor of _steel balls_. _Physics objects_ such as assembled cargo containers _slide_ over it, players and mobs keep their grip.
block.createairspace.cargo_container.too: Build a _ULD_ from these blocks. Each block holds as much as an _Item Vault_ block. The _dock side_ shows a _lock point_ and _port points_.
When Placed in a ULD Shape
Joins into one container: _1x1x2_ is an LD2, _2x2x2_ an LD3 with contour, _3x2x2_ an LD11, _3x3x3_ an AMA. Other shapes stay _loose_.
A _Physics Assembler_ takes the whole container as _one piece_, no glue needed. The floor stays behind.
Turns the _dock side_ to the next side, the _contour_ of an LD3 turns with it.
block.createairspace.container_lock.tool: Holds a cargo container. Fits _into the floor_ under it or _into the wall_ next to it. Containers _slide_ over it like over a Roller Bed.
_Pulls in_ the lock point of an assembled container like a _magnet_, lines it up and _grips_ it. Nothing pulls it off again.
_Lets go_ of the container. A _Comparator_ shows whether a container is locked.
block.createairspace.container_port.tool: Sits in the _wall_ next to a docked container, like a _Portable Storage Interface_.
When a Container Is Locked in Front
Connects to a _port point_ that faces it. _Funnels_, _chutes_ and other logistics at the port then _fill_ or _empty_ the container.
